onboarding.languageLead: This sets the language for the CMAE interface and for translated copies of your emails. Application emails to companies still follow each company’s language.
onboarding.localePrepLead: CMAE is translating the interface into your language. This only takes a moment, and runs again if you change language later.
onboarding.localePrepFail: Language setup failed — please choose a language again.
onboarding.localePrepWait0: Larger languages can take a little longer…
onboarding.welcomeLead: CMAE helps you research companies, draft personalized applications, keep Gmail drafts ready, and track follow-ups — all in one place.
onboarding.profileWhy: Your name appears in email text and in CV attachment filenames (for example First_Last_CV.pdf). Next you will connect Gmail.
onboarding.gmailWhy: CMAE reads your inbox and sent mail, and saves application and follow-up drafts in Gmail Drafts. Use a Google App Password — not your normal Gmail password. It stays encrypted on this computer only; it is never sent to our servers or any third-party cloud.
onboarding.gmailPrivacy: Your App Password is encrypted and stored only on this computer. It is never sent to our servers or any third-party cloud.
onboarding.gmailGuide0: Enable two-step verification on your Google account.
onboarding.gmailGuide2: Name the app (for example {app}) and create the password.
onboarding.gmailGuide3: Copy the 16-digit password and paste it below.
onboarding.cursorWhy: This key powers company research, email drafting, and follow-up suggestions in CMAE. It stays encrypted on this computer only; it is never uploaded to our servers or any third-party cloud.
onboarding.cursorPrivacy: Your Cursor API key is encrypted and stored only on this computer. It is never uploaded to our servers or any third-party cloud.
onboarding.cursorGuide1: Create a new API key (any name, for example {name}).
onboarding.cursorGuide2: Copy the key and paste it below.
onboarding.prefsWhy: Choose when an application should show as ready for follow-up in Tracker, and the signature added at the end of every email. CMAE never sends mail or notifications for you — you always send from Gmail yourself.
onboarding.jobWhy: Work type and notice period can appear in application and follow-up text. Salary is only mentioned in replies when the employer asks; CMAE never adds it on its own.
onboarding.cvWhy: At least one PDF is required to finish setup. CMAE uses it to personalize emails and attaches it to application and follow-up drafts in Gmail. You can add more languages and labels later in Settings.
onboarding.bootLead: CMAE is confirming your Gmail connection and Cursor key. If something is wrong, you will go back to that step to fix it.
onboarding.bootFail: Returning to that step so you can fix it…

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.subtitle: Follow every application in one list. Drafts go to Gmail; you always send them yourself.
tracker.helpBody0: Tracker brings together Gmail application threads and companies from Research.
tracker.helpBody1: Each row is one application: its status, latest activity, and the next actions you can take. Open a row for a timeline of that conversation.
tracker.helpStep0: Run Gmail sync to load recent mail. Turn on Thorough sync if something looks missing (last ~30 days).
tracker.helpStep1: Companies from Research also appear here automatically.
tracker.helpStep2: For a follow-up, reply, or thank-you, use the action — CMAE writes a draft into Gmail Drafts.
tracker.helpStep3: Click a company row to open its timeline. You always send from Gmail yourself; CMAE never sends mail for you.

folders.title: Folders
folders.subtitle: Browse research files and company folders like {fileManager}, and preview what you need.
folders.helpBody0: Each research run creates a company folder with notes, drafts, and related files.
folders.helpBody1: Browse here without leaving the app. Rename or delete folders when you no longer need them.
folders.helpStep0: Choose a company folder from the list on the left.
folders.helpStep1: Click a file to preview it.
folders.helpStep2: Rename or delete folders as needed — Tracker stays in sync.
folders.helpStep3: CV files can also be managed more easily in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Update your profile, Gmail, Cursor key, and job preferences.
settings.helpBody0: Everything from setup lives here. Changes apply to new drafts right away.
settings.helpBody1: Your Gmail App Password and Cursor API key are encrypted and stored only on this computer.
settings.helpStep0: Update your name and language under Profile — new drafts follow these.
settings.helpStep1: To change Gmail or Cursor details, paste a new value; leave the field blank to keep the current one.
settings.helpStep2: Job preferences (work type, notice period, salary) shape application and follow-up wording.
settings.helpStep3: Add PDF CVs here; they attach to drafts based on language and tags.

research.title: Research
research.subtitle: Paste company or careers page URLs. CMAE finds contacts and prepares an outreach draft.
research.helpBody0: Start research with one or more URLs. Each link is processed on its own so you can run several in parallel.
research.helpBody1: Results are saved under Folders; good matches also show up in Tracker.
research.helpStep0: Paste careers or company URLs (one per line, or separated by commas).
research.helpStep1: Start research — CMAE reviews the site, looks for contacts, and drafts an email.
research.helpStep2: Re-open earlier runs from the history list on the left.
research.helpStep3: When a run finishes, check Tracker and send the draft from Gmail.
